title: Pelvic Health After Breast Cancer Therapy Study
summary: Breast cancer is now treated successfully with different types of medication. However, little is known about how these treatments may affect pelvic health, urinary leakage, and sexual well-being. In this study, women who have completed curative breast cancer treatment complete a one-time questionnaire about these symptoms. Additional relevant medical information is obtained from their medical records. The aim is to describe how common these symptoms are and to explore whether they are associated with different breast cancer treatments.
conditions: Breast cancer; pelvic floor disorders after breast cancer therapy

interventions.name: Women with histologically confirmed, curatively treated breast cancer are recruited during routine follow-up care at the University Hospital Schleswig-Holstein (UKSH), Campus Kiel. criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Postmenopausal women
Histologically confirmed breast cancer
Curatively treated patients
Routine follow-up care at UKSH Campus Kiel
Sufficient German language proficiency
Written informed consent
Exclusion criteria:
Age below 18 years
Male sex
Presence of distant metastases
Inability to understand the study information or to provide written informed consent independently
